method: Unmodified production oscillator/journey functions and hub in Node VM; deterministic recording AudioParams, graph nodes, DOM and clocks. Not a native browser, rendered/audible sound, screen-lock or physical-device acceptance.

checks.name: Repeated Start/Stop owns one graph and a stopped graph never revives

Timer starts on playback, freezes with audio pause and expires without changing saved volume
Timer cancellation removes the old deadline and does not stop a fresh session later
Sweep keeps fixed beat spacing, survives rebuild, freezes on Pause and retires on Stop
A separate chakra journey retires a running sweep before taking oscillator ownership
